各位同志：
我们于六月从贵处返回的代表已抵达此地。同时收到了你们的两封信以及由 Koak Jin（易 籯）带回的款项（共计1,000荷兰盾和800美国金元）。
我们将接受你们关于我们工作的建议和意见，并准备在近期召开一次扩大会议，依据你们其中一封信中所载的第十三届全体会议指示，重新调整我党工作。
现就另一封信中所提问题答复如下：
1. 目前我们尚无法与爪哇共产党建立直接联系。
我们只能与一些老工作部的同志取得联系，他们曾在1926年负责地方委员会的工作，并刚从迪古尔岛（Digoel Island）——一个拘留营——回来。我们现在正协助他们整顿活动。也许这样做就有可能吸收当地的党组织并与爪哇的党组织取得联系。（但是……是否……仍存疑

当我们想与他们交谈或写信时，我们需要一个懂荷兰语和马来语的人来承担这项工作。但我们这里没有这样的人。我们甚至没有一个懂英语的同志。希望贵方能帮助我们解决这一难题。我们与暹罗的联系刚刚建立，我们正在开展所有必要的工作。至于缅甸方面的工作，在目前情况下，我们不可能承担派遣一名缅甸学生去那里的责任。我们同意稍后派遣。

2. 我们同意派遣代表出席第七次世界大会，我们的一位同志已经启程前往贵处。但我们不知道他是否已经与你们取得联系。请回复。在目前情况下，我们无法应你们的要求从印度尼西亚派遣代表出席会议。

3. 我们已经向贵处派遣了两名学生。你们已经与他们取得联系了吗？请回复。这两名学生是本地出生的产业工人。他们在马来亚居住已久，并无移民之意。我们找不到比这两人更合适的人选，因此……

pages.en:
- Page 3 -

fore we decided to send them to you. Regarding
the sending of an Indian student it could be
easily done if not for the fact that the time
given by you is too limited and the procedure
for a Indian student to go abroad is too laborious,
and could not be accomplished within the short
period of time. Therefore no Indian student
has been sent. Regarding Malay students we have
already found two who are poor peasants. But
they could not leave their family and when we
sent for them, they did turn up but run away
afterwards secretly. We are prepared to send
Malay and Indian students to your place. But
the procedure governing their going abroad is
indeed a very difficult problem. The following
is our opinion: For Malays going abroad in
this country is indeed a rare thing because the
majority of them are poor people. The position
of the Indian people is almost similar. Our
request is that you will find a Malay and an
Indian comrade in Shanghai asking them each
send a telegram to us (or a letter) saying that
they (the Malay and Indian comrades in Shanghai)
have found employment for our Malay and Indian
comrades here and asking them to go to Shanghai
immediately. It would be best if the sender of
the telegram has proper employment and can give
us his fixed address. Then we can make use of
the telegrams as a camouflage. It will be
comparatively more convenient. If this is not
workable we request you to allow us a longer
period of time, or leave the matter to us to
decide...
pages.zh:
- 第3页 -

因此我们决定派遣他们去贵处。关于派遣印度学生一事，若非贵方给予的时间太短，且印度学生出国手续过于繁琐，无法在短时间内完成，本可轻易办妥。因此未派遣印度学生。关于马来学生，我们已经找到了两名贫农。但他们无法离开家庭，当我们召见他们时，他们虽然出现了，但随后秘密逃走了。我们准备向贵处派遣马来和印度学生。但他们出国的手续确实是一个非常棘手的问题。以下是我们的意见：在这个国家，马来人出国确实是罕见之事，因为他们大多数是穷人。印度人的情况几乎相同。我们的请求是，请你们在上海找一名马来同志和一名印度同志，让他们每人给我们发一封电报（或信件），称他们（上海的马来和印度同志）已为我们这里的马来和印度同志找到了工作，并请他们立即前往上海。如果发报人有正当职业并能提供固定地址，那就最好了。这样我们可以利用这些电报作为掩护。这将比较方便。如果此法不可行，我们请求你们给予更长的时间，或将此事留由我们决定……

pages.en:
- Page 4 -

decide. We try to secure seaman's job for them
so that when their ship touches Shanghai (after
leaving New York) you can then get in touch with
them. The last mentioned method seems more
practicable but it may take a long time before
we can secure work for them. Which method do you
prefer please reply? We have not yet found
suitable addresses for your Malay and Indian
comrades to send their letters to or telegrams
to; but if you agree to this method we shall send
them to you.

4. Regarding the question of the organization of
Central:
The suggestions made by you regarding the Political
Bureau, the extension of the Political Bureau
Committee, and the constitution of the Political
Bureau Committee are regarded by us as principally
correct. We prepare to submit these suggestions
for discussion at the greater conference.

5. When should the six months' subsidy given by you
to us be calculated. If it is to be calculated
from the month of July, the amount we received from
you, after paying off all the debts incurred in the
previous months, will leave not more than $500.
This small amount of money is hardly sufficient
for us to carry on with our works here and to
assist the organizations in Indonesia, Siam and
Burma. (Also the C.Y. corps and the Labour Unions).
For this reason we request the China Communist
Party to pay us the subsidy which they promised
previously....
pages.zh:
- 第4页 -

决定。我们试图为他们谋取海员职位，以便当他们的船只停靠上海时（离开纽约后），你们便可与他们取得联系。后一种方法似乎更可行，但我们可能需要很长时间才能为他们找到工作。请问你们倾向于哪种方法，请回复？我们尚未找到合适的地址供你们的马来和印度同志寄送信件或电报；但如果你们同意此方法，我们将把地址发给你们。

4. 关于中央组织问题：
你们关于政治局、扩大政治局委员会以及组建政治局委员会的建议，我们认为大体上是正确的。我们准备将这些建议提交扩大会议讨论。

5. 贵方给予我们的六个月津贴应从何时算起。如果从七月算起，我们在偿还前几个月产生的所有债务后，从贵方收到的款项将不超过500美元。这笔微薄的资金很难维持我们在这里的工作以及援助印度尼西亚、暹罗和缅甸的组织。（还包括青年团和工会）。为此，我们请求中国共产党支付他们此前承诺的津贴……

pages.en:
- Page 5 -

previously. The money which we borrowed for use
is from the funds in support of the Chinese Soviet
Revolution which is the money of the masses and
this must be repaid. We now request you to
calculate your subsidy as beginning from the month
of April up to the month of September, and pay us
the arrears.

6. We propose to prolong the period of our liaison
with you up till the end of the year because we
are going to hold a greater conference in the near
future. After the closing of the conference there
must be plenty of works to be done. At that time
we must send some one to get in contact with you.
We shall let you know when the conference is to be
held and you will let us know the address where our
men can get in touch with you. Did our delegate
IUN CHIN SUN(楊進孫,) make known to you our most
pressing needs:
(a) Immediately send a comrade here who is capable
of taking up the secretary work because after
the arrest of BUN TEK CHAI (文德才) we are
facing great difficulty in the issuing of Party
papers and other literary works.
(b) The Malayan General Labour Union will hold a
representative conference in the near future.
Will you please inform the International Red
Labour Union and the Pan Pacific Secretariat
to send their representatives to attend this
conference. What is your reply to these two
problems?

The.......
pages.zh:
- 第5页 -

此前承诺的津贴。我们借用的资金来自支援中国苏维埃革命的基金，这是群众的钱，必须偿还。现在我们请求你们将津贴计算期定为从四月到九月，并支付欠款。

6. 我们提议将与你们的联络期限延长至年底，因为我们将在近期召开一次扩大会议。会议结束后，必然有大量工作需要完成。届时我们必须派人去与你们联系。我们会通知你们会议召开的时间，也请你们告知我们的人员可以与你们取得联系的地址。我们的代表 IUN CHIN SUN（楊進孫）是否已向你们通报了我们要紧的需求：
(a) 立即派遣一名能胜任秘书工作的同志来这里，因为在 BUN TEK CHAI（文德才）被捕后，我们在发行党刊和其他文学作品方面面临巨大困难。
(b) 马来亚总工会将在近期召开代表大会。请你们通知国际红色工会泛太平洋秘书处派遣代表出席此次会议。你们对这两个问题的答复是什么？

……

pages.en:
- Page 7 -

Kok Bun(國文),
This letter simply inform you the following
questions :-
We have already collected funds up to the amount
of $1,000 for the support of the Chinese Soviet Revolution.
Our delegate must have informed you about this money. Our
delegate was instructed to request you to deduct $400 from
the subsidy you promised to give us (for the months of
March - June) and the remaining $600 will be sent to you
when we have received a more reliable address from you.
Our delegate was also instructed to request you to publish
in the Soviet papers the amount we collected or give us
official receipt, but you haven't given us any reply.
The arrears of subsidy have also not been sent to us.
It is not known whether the $400 has already been deducted.
The masses requested that their contribution be published
in the Soviet Newspapers.

Our opinions towards these questions are :-
1. You will deduct the contribution which we
promised to send to you from the money
which you agreed to grant to us for the
months of March to June. We request you
to do so because for these few months you
did not send us the money so we have to
spend a great part of the money collected.
You will deduct $450 (American gold) from
the amount and we will send you the rest
of the money when we have got your reliable
address.

(2)..
pages.zh:
- 第7页 -

Kok Bun（國文）：
此信仅告知你以下事项：
我们为支援中国苏维埃革命已筹集了1,000美元的款项。我们的代表一定已就此款项通知了你。我们的代表奉命请求你从承诺给我们的津贴（三月至六月）中扣除400美元，剩余的600美元将在我们收到你更可靠的地址后寄给你。我们的代表还奉命请求你在苏维埃报刊上公布我们筹集的金额或给我们出具正式收据，但你未予回复。津贴欠款也未寄给我们。不知400美元是否已经扣除。群众要求将他们的捐款刊登在苏维埃报纸上。

我们对这些问题的意见是：
1. 请从你们同意在三至六月期间拨给我们的款项中，扣除我们承诺寄给你们的捐款。我们请求你们这样做，因为在这几个月里你们未给我们汇款，所以我们不得不花掉筹集的大部分资金。请从中扣除450美元（美国金元），待我们收到你们的可靠地址后，我们将把余款寄给你们。

(2)..

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.    File No. .........

Section 2, Special Branch Station,
REPORT
Date October 1, 1934.

Subject (in full) Letter dated September 25, 1934, from H.B.M. Consulate-General
re: letter intercepted in Singapore and two addresses in Shanghai.

Made by D.I. Kuh Pao-hwa Forwarded by [Signature] A.1.

With reference to the translation of a letter forwarded
together with the above communique, enquiries show that this
refers to a watch kept on certain communist suspects who once
resided in the Shang Ping ( 香 賓 ) Lodging House, 240 Yunnan Road,
from August 2, 1934, (vide File D-6018).

Careful enquiries made into the two addresses contained
in the above letter elicit the following :-

(A) Mr. Lau Chu An,
Ping An Hotel,
Chu Pao San Road,
Avenue Edward VII.

This refers to the two letters addressed to the afore-
mentioned individual who was believed to be residing in the Ping
An Hotel, 14-16 Rue Chu Pao San, French Concession, for whom a
watch was kept between August 5 and September 29, 1934, by the
Municipal Police in conjunction with French detectives, but the
prospective recipient failed to claim delivery of same (vide
report forwarded on 27.9.34).

(B) Mr. Oh Kok Cheng,
An Tung ( 安 東 ),
Ta Hsin Street ( 大 新 街 ),
Shanghai.

This refers to the Ang Tung ( 安 東 ) Hotel, 123 Hupeh
Road. Enquiries show that no lodger answering to the romanization
of the name given resided in this hotel between August 20 and
September 10, 1934.

cos. 41 assisted in enquiry    Kuh Pao hwa
Kuh.    D. I.

Spare copy attached. [Signature] 1/10.
Officer i/c Special Branch.

特科第二股，
报告
日期：1934年10月1日。

主题（全称）：关于英国驻上海总领事馆1934年9月25日来信，涉及在新加坡截获的信件及上海的两个地址。

制作：督察 Kuh Pao-hwa 转发：[签名] A.1.

关于随上述公函一并转交的信件译文，经查询，该信涉及对某些共产党嫌疑人的监视，这些人曾于1934年8月2日起居住在云南路240号的香宾（Shang Ping）旅馆（参见档案 D-6018）。

对上述信件中包含的两个地址进行的仔细查询结果如下：

(A) Lau Chu An 先生，
平安饭店，
朱葆三路，
爱多亚路。

这指的是寄给上述个人的两封信，此人被认为居住在法租界朱葆三路14-16号的平安饭店。1934年8月5日至9月29日期间，工部局警务处会同法国侦探对其进行了监视，但预期收件人未能领取信件（参见1934年9月27日转交的报告）。

(B) Oh Kok Cheng 先生，
安东（An Tung），
大新街，
上海。

这指的是湖北路123号的安东（Ang Tung）旅馆。查询显示，1934年8月20日至9月10日期间，该旅馆没有姓名罗马拼音与所给名称相符的住客。

cos. 41 协助查询    Kuh Pao hwa
Kuh.    督察

附备用副本一份。 [签名] 10月1日。
特科主管警官。

My dear Robertson,

I enclose, herewith, translation of a
letter from the central of the Malayan Communist Party,
most probably addressed to LI SU KONG (李桂松)

（批：x See also
D 6018/01）

This letter is interesting, as the original
was in code numbers which have been decyphered , as well as
in secret ink, which has been developed. It is important to
note that an identical letter was sent to the following

Mr. Lau Chu An.
Ping An Hotel
Chu Pao San R.J
Ap Sfew Yu

Mr. Oh Kok Cheung.
An Tung (安東) (大新街)
Ta New Street Shanghai

Could these addresses as well as those in
the body of the letter be investigated please, and if any are
in the Native City, could the Public Safety Bureau be informed
please ?.

Yours sincerely,
（签名）

T. Robertson Esq.,
Special Branch,

（批：S V
27/9/34）
（批：D.I. Koh
D.S.R. 28/9.）

Section 2, Special Branch
REPORT

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE File No. S.B. REGISTRY. No D/6159 Date September 27 1934）

Subject (in full) Enquiry from H.B.M. Consulate-General re Lieu Ts Oen (刘子安)-
suspected communist.

Made by D.S.I. Duncan Forwarded by J. Duncan. S.I.

In connection with the verbal enquiry from H.B.M.
Consulate re a communist suspect named Lieu Ts Oen (刘子安),
a careful examination of our records has failed to establish
the identity of this person.

On September 4 a letter addressed to Lieu Ts Oen
was delivered to the Bing An (平安) Lodging House, 14-16 Rue
Chu Pao San and since then a watch has been kept at the lodging
house but no one has appeared to claim the letter.

A further letter (translation attached) was delivered
addressed to the same person on September 8.

Whounean
D. S. I.

（批：Copy handed to A G AS 1:15）
Officer i/c Special Branch （批：SMB /10.）

（印章：上海公共租界工部局警务处 档案号 特别科登记处 编号 D/6159 日期 1934年9月27日）

主题（全称） 英国驻华总领事馆关于刘子安（Lieu Ts Oen）——
疑似共产党员——的查询。

由副助理警司邓肯撰写 由警司 J. 邓肯转发。

针对英国驻华总领事馆就一名名为刘子安（Lieu Ts Oen）的
共产党员嫌疑人进行的口头查询，经仔细查阅我方记录，未能
确认此人身份。

9月4日，一封写给刘子安的信被送达赵家浜路14-16号
平安（Bing An）旅馆，此后一直对该旅馆进行监视，但无人
前来认领该信件。

另一封信（附译文）于9月8日送达，收件人同为
此人。

惠恩
副助理警司

（批注：副本交予 A G AS 1:15）
特别科主管警官 （批注：SMB /10.）

pages.en:
Translation of a letter dated 27.8.34 addressed to one
Lieu Ts Oen (刘子安) c/o Bing An (平安) Lodging House,
14-16 Rue Chu Pao San, French Concession.

---------

ENVELOPE

Mr. Lieu Ts Oen ( 刘子安 )
Bing An Lodging House, Rue Chu Pao San,
Avenue Edward VII, Shanghai.

From Liu ( 刘    ).             (Mailed at Singapore, 28.8.34)

__________________________________________________________________

Cousin Ts Oen,

Tuh Sung ( 德生 ) said you had returned to Swatow
but Chiu Sung ( 秋生 ) said you were still in Shanghai and
he had seen you. Are you still in Shanghai? Why haven't
you sent me a letter for so long a time?

Please send me a reply as soon as you have received
this letter. I shall have very much to tell you after
receiving your reply.

Wishing you good health.

Kwong ( 光 ), 27.8.34.

P.S. My home is as usual and you may send your letter to
my home.
pages.zh:
1934年8月27日写给法租界
赵家浜路14-16号平安（Bing An）旅馆转交
刘子安（Lieu Ts Oen）的一封信的译文。

---------

信封

刘子安先生（ 刘子安 ）
上海爱德华七世路，赵家浜路，
平安旅馆。

发自 刘（ 刘    ）。             （1934年8月28日于新加坡投邮）

__________________________________________________________________

子安表弟：

德生（Tuh Sung）说你已返回汕头，
但秋生（Chiu Sung）说你仍在上海，
且他见过你。你还在上海吗？为何这么久
没给我写信？

收到此信后请尽快回信。收到你的回信后，
我有很多事要告诉你。

祝好。

光（Kwong），1934年8月27日。

附言：我家一切如常，你可将信寄到
我家。

Translation of extracts from French Police Daily Intelligence
Report dated October 26, 1934.

Parag.1. Arrest of Communists in the French Concession.

On October 22, acting on information received from the
Public Safety Bureau, the French Police raided the following
addresses :-

1) House No.1, Passage 79, Route Vallon, where communist
documents were seized and LI Y WEI(李一凡) and a female
named CHANG LAI TSENG(張雨珍) were arrested.

2) House No.2, Song Pah Li, Rue Lemaire, where one CHENG TSE
LING(陳子林) was arrested. A search of the room occupied
by him revealed a quantity of communist documents, among
which was a manuscript relating to plan of work of agents
of the Chinese Communist Party. Chang Tse Ling's wife
named CHENG VENG SOH(陳又淑) was also placed under arrest.
of each

A watch kept in the vicinity of the above two houses
resulted in the arrest at House No.1, Passage 79, Route Vallon,
of one HUANG CHING(汪清), age 24, native of Sing-Yang (Hunan)
and at House No.2, Song Pah Li, Rue Lemaire, of one LOH LAI
FANG(陸蘭芳), age 20, native of Cho Fou (Szechuen).

Parag.2. A Communist Sentenced.
(In continuation of our report dated 29/9/34, parag.3.)

CHANG CHENG FOU alias CHANG PING SHAN, who had been
arrested by the French Police on September 28 in Rue Brenier
de Montmorand, was sentenced by the 3rd Branch Kiangsu High
Court on October 24 to six months imprisonment. It will be
recalled that the accused was found in possession of documents
relating to communist propaganda among local workers.

Parag.3. Arrest of a suspected agent of the G.P.U.

On October 23, acting on information received from
the Public Safety Bureau, the French Police carried out a
raid on House No.14, Passage 833, Avenue Joffre, occupied
by a boarding-house conducted by a Russian lady.

According to information furnished by agents of the
Public Safety Bureau two Chinese, who are agents of the
G.P.U., were living in that house. A search of the room
occupied by the two individuals failed to reveal anything
of an incriminating nature.

A watch kept in the vicinity of the house in question
led to arrest on October 23 of one HOU VENG TSING(吳文俊),
age 40, native of Sing Hwa( Hunan), unemployed and without
any visible means of existence.

1934年10月26日法国警察每日情报报告
摘录译文。

第1段. 法租界逮捕共产党员。

10月22日，根据从公安局获得的情报，法国警察
突袭了以下地址：-

1) 瓦隆路（Route Vallon）79弄1号，在此查获共产党
文件，并逮捕了李一凡（LI Y WEI）和一名名为张雨珍
（CHANG LAI TSENG）的女子。

2) 勒梅尔路（Rue Lemaire）宋家里2号，在此逮捕了
陈子林（CHENG TSE LING）一人。对其居住的房间进行搜
查，发现了大量共产党文件，其中包括一份关于中国共产党
特工工作计划的手稿。陈子林的妻子陈又淑
（CHENG VENG SOH）也被逮捕。
每人

在上述两处房屋附近进行监视，结果在瓦隆路
79弄1号逮捕了汪清（HUANG CHING），24岁，湖南新阳
（Sing-Yang）人；在勒梅尔路宋家里2号逮捕了陆兰芳
（LOH LAI FANG），20岁，四川卓富（Cho Fou）人。

第2段. 一名共产党员被判刑。
（续1934年9月29日报告第3段。）

张慎夫，又名张彬山（CHANG CHENG FOU alias CHANG PING SHAN），
于9月28日在布雷尼埃·德·蒙莫朗路（Rue Brenier de Montmorand）
被法国警察逮捕，10月24日被江苏高等法院第二分院判处
六个月监禁。回顾此前，被告被发现持有涉及在当地工人中
进行共产主义宣传的文件。

第3段. 逮捕一名疑似格鲁乌（G.P.U.）特工。

10月23日，根据从公安局获得的情报，法国警察
突袭了霞飞路（Avenue Joffre）833弄14号，该处由一位
俄罗斯女士经营的寄宿公寓占用。

根据公安局特工提供的情报，两名中国籍格鲁乌
（G.P.U.）特工居住在该屋内。对这两人居住的房间进行
搜查，未发现任何具有定罪性质的物品。

在该房屋附近进行监视，导致10月23日逮捕了
吴文俊（HOU VENG TSING），40岁，湖南兴华（Sing Hwa）人，
无业，无任何可见的生活来源。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
Translation of extracts from French Police Daily Intelligence Re-
port dated September 29,1934.
No. D

Parag. 1. Arrest of an agent of the Chinese G.P.U. by the S.M.Police.

At about 2.45 p.m. on September 27,at the request of a
representative of the Public Safety Bureau,C.P.C. 2710, arrested
at the corner of Chengtu Road and Avenue Foch one MENG VAI TING
(孟萬亭 ),age 26, native of Hopei. According to the P.S.B.
agent the individual arrested was an associate of persons respon-
sible for the assassinations at the Chinese Lester Hospital on
September 26.

Being interrogated the prisoner stated that he had no
fixed abode in Shanghai.

The ten persons ( 6 males and 4 females) who had been ar-
rested on September 27,were brought before the 2nd Branch,Kiangsu
High Court , on September 28,when the case against them was reman-
ded sine die. fur further enquiries.

Parag.2. Arrest of a communist in the French Concession.

On September 28 the French Police arrested on Rue Brenier
de Montmorand a Chinese in possession of documents relating to
communist activities,who gave his name as CHANG CHENG FOU (張慎夫)
alias CHANG PING SHAN (張彬山 ),age 20,native of Linchuan,
Kiangsi.

Being interrogated he stated that he resided at No 18
Rue Colbert. The premises were searched,but nothing of an incri-
minating nature was found. According to occupants of House No 18
Rue Colbert,the accused never resided at that address.

Among the documents in possession of Chang were:-

1. A manuscript relating to the strike at the Shanghai
Tramway Company.
2. A manuscript entitled" The Struggle against Imperia-
lists continues".
3. A manuscript on the subject of working conditions
in Shanghai factories.
4. A blank enquiry form regarding piece goods facto-
ries.

上海公共租界工部局警务处
1934年9月29日法国警察每日情报报告
摘录译文。
编号 D

第1段. 上海公共租界警务处逮捕一名中国格鲁乌（G.P.U.）特工。

9月27日下午约2时45分，应公安局代表请求，中央巡捕房
2710号在成都路与福煦路转角逮捕了孟万亭
（MENG VAI TING），26岁，河北人。据公安局
特工称，被捕者与9月26日发生在中式莱斯特医院
（Chinese Lester Hospital）的刺杀案责任人有关联。

经审讯，囚犯称其在上海无固定住所。

9月27日被捕的十人（6男4女）于9月28日被提
至江苏高等法院第二分院，针对他们的案件因需进一步
调查而被无限期延期审理。

第2段. 法租界逮捕一名共产党员。

9月28日，法国警察在布雷尼埃·德·蒙莫朗路
（Rue Brenier de Montmorand）逮捕了一名持有涉及共产
党活动文件的中国人，其自报姓名为张慎夫
（CHANG CHENG FOU），又名张彬山（CHANG PING SHAN），
20岁，江西临川人。

经审讯，他称其居住在科尔贝路（Rue Colbert）18号。
对该处所进行了搜查，但未发现任何具有定罪性质的物品。
据科尔贝路18号的住户称，被告从未在该地址居住过。

张慎夫持有的文件中包括：-

1. 一份关于上海电车公司罢工的手稿。
2. 一份题为《反帝斗争继续》的手稿。
3. 一份关于上海工厂工作条件的手稿。
4. 一份关于棉布厂的空白的调查表。
